name: SWAC Cross Country Championships
headline: SWAC Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Jackson State won the men's 8K with 41 points to Texas Southern's 51, led by freshman Ryan Achau, who won in 25:09.5 ahead of Bethune-Cookman's Jayden Santos-Gonzales (25:12.2). Alabama A&M won the women's 5K with 37 points to Florida A&M's 41, and Alabama A&M senior Laura Avila won in 18:16.4.
